scope: Four independent model reviews of the same synthetic RNA planning problem: two evidence states by two action orders. No reads, expression analysis or laboratory workflow.

wire_projection.unchanged: Question, candidate claims, action card text/IDs, source IDs and response schema; shared instructions correct the old statement that readiness is supplied. Across cells only supplied sample metadata and displayed candidate order vary.
wire_projection.excluded: Authored rubric, expected first actions/verdicts, phase names, readiness hints, human reviews/notes, credentials, paths, prior replies.
wire_projection.shared_instruction_change: Replace readiness-supplied wording with: infer input dependencies only from supplied records. Same instruction in every cell.

primary_unique_label_judgment.limit: Judges unique supplied labels only; never independent units, replication or readiness.

missing_read_count.must_not_infer: A measured read count of zero or a nonzero count from absent files.

unsupported_success.limit: No differential-expression, analysis-ready, biological or reproducibility success is established.

priority_reference.qualification: Secondary authored-rubric agreement, not a truth criterion. A gap-ledger-first choice can be defensible; retain the rationale for human review.

criteria.citation_coverage: Known IDs required. For actions, required card citations may be supplemented by other supplied records; exact-equality score is retained only as strict v1 secondary metric. IDs alone do not establish entailment.
criteria.order_comparison: Compare first ID, selected set, and rank order under original/reversed presentation separately in each evidence state. Disagreement is an observation, not proof of position bias from one response per cell.
criteria.evidence_comparison: Compare the unique-label verdict and first action across evidence states within each presentation. Evidence changes resolve duplicate labels AND conflicting layouts together; effects cannot be attributed to either alone.
criteria.human_review: Relevance, feasibility, priority, completion check and source entailment remain unscored pending human review. Expected alternatives are not silently recoded.

limits: No hidden benchmark: all criteria are openly inspectable, but withheld from model bodies.
One response per cell, one synthetic RNA scenario family. No repeated-run reliability, causal estimate, statistical significance or generalization across research areas.
Only fixed documentation/data-check proposals are ranked. Card text is authored; model rationale and ordering are evaluated separately.
All earlier cases, fixtures, criteria versions and completed run records are preserved.
